For each distinct sites.healtheval value, calculate the mean of gbsize / spanmin over matched scans with nonmissing gbsize and nonmissing, nonzero spanmin. Let the all-status average be the unweighted mean of those status-level rates with defined values. Select statuses whose rate exceeds that average; select none if the all-status average is missing. In one unrounded row, report the unweighted mean of the selected statuses’ rates, the unweighted mean of their counts of all matched scan rows, and the unweighted mean of their rate minus the all-status average.

Join scans to sites on scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry and discard unmatched scans. For each distinct sites.healtheval value, calculate the mean of gbsize / spanmin over matched scans with nonmissing gbsize and nonmissing, nonzero spanmin. Let the all-status average be the unweighted mean of those status-level rates with defined values. Select statuses whose rate exceeds that average; select none if the all-status average is missing. In one unrounded row, report the unweighted mean of the selected statuses’ rates, the unweighted mean of their status-level averages of scans.scancount (ignoring missing scancount values), and the unweighted mean of their rate minus the all-status average.
queries:
WITH status_rates AS (
    SELECT
        sites.healtheval,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL
             AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL
             AND scans.spanmin <> 0
            THEN scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin
        END) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS scan_count
    FROM scans
    JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY sites.healtheval
),
all_status AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate
    FROM status_rates
)
SELECT
    AVG(status_rates.rate) AS mean_rate,
    AVG(status_rates.scan_count) AS mean_scan_count,
    AVG(status_rates.rate - all_status.average_rate) AS mean_rate_excess
FROM status_rates
CROSS JOIN all_status
WHERE status_rates.rate > all_status.average_rate

WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    sites.healtheval,
    AVG(CASE
      WHEN scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL
       AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL
       AND scans.spanmin <> 0
      THEN scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin
    END) AS rate,
    AVG(scans.scancount) AS avg_scancount
  FROM scans
  JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sites.healtheval
),
all_status AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(status_rates.rate) AS avg_selected_rate,
  AVG(status_rates.avg_scancount) AS avg_selected_scancount,
  AVG(status_rates.rate - all_status.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_excess
FROM status_rates
CROSS JOIN all_status
WHERE status_rates.rate > all_status.avg_rate
